mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without any threshold condition.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a weakening labor market that typically precedes corporate earnings deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in consumer credit (RSAFS) and rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates a tightening financial environment that suppresses consumer spending and equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS declines and FEDFUNDS rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening manufacturing activity that precedes a recession, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansion when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1300 thousand units, it indicates a cooling real estate market that typically reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 1300, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption (GDPC1) indicates strong economic growth that supports corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without any threshold condition.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 is rising, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In post-shock recovery periods, a stable federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals policy normalization that supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances during post-shock recovery when FEDFUNDS is stable, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment (PAYEMS) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown that typically precedes a market correction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS and INDPRO both decline, or the Rank IC over 2-year windows is below 0.03.
